data.standardized_narrative: Gross claims outstanding increased materially during 2017 (from 31.923m at 1 Jan 2017 to 266.152m at 31 Dec 2017) driven by 2017 loss activity and development of the 2017 underwriting year. There is no explicit quantified gross prior-year (pre-2016/2015-and-earlier) reserve movement disclosed in the notes; the claims development table shows minimal development on the older years and the large movement on the balance sheet is attributable to current year activity.
raw_causal_phrases: Effect of FX and other movements
data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Statement of Financial Position (liabilities - Claims outstanding). No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' figure was found in the notes; the claims development table is present but sparse for pre-2016 years, and the large increase in 2017 claims outstanding is driven by 2017 underwriting year activity. Prior-year development therefore could not be quantified from a clear gross movement note and is returned as null. The claims development triangle was used as a corroborating source but provides limited data for older years.
